symptom: Regression from #2546: exec stored TextTemplate null for script-set labels of a widget whose editorConfig hides them only while an ATTRIBUTE is unbound (EvaluationBar textMaterial/textEngine, MoveList textBrilliant..textBlunder, KnightShift); the labels rendered blank, while check, docker check and mx check all passed (ako/mxcli#2548).
cause: Build step 4.10 ran getProperties with builder.PrimitiveValues() only, so an attribute (or expression, action) the statement binds reached it as unset and `!isSet(values.evaluation)` fired; the hidden-property resets and check passed configurationValues(stored, script) and disagreed.
fix: Step 4.10 evaluates configurationValues(builder.PrimitiveValues(), scriptValues), the same configuration as the resets and check.
insight: Three consumers asked the same question with three value sets; the one that writes BSON had the narrowest. When a decision is computed per consumer, the values each passes are part of the contract — the #2546 unit tests used only primitive conditions (a boolean, an expression's text), which is why none of them could see it. The reporter's diff against a nightly-written model (exec writing a change where none was made) was the signal; a describe of the page after exec on a copy shows the labels gone on main and kept with the fix.
test: mdl/executor/editorconfig_eval_2548_test.go TestEvaluatedVisibility_BuildSeesTheBoundAttribute (failed before the fix); live: KnightShift 28-play-match-page.mdl on a copy, main rewrites Play.Match_View and drops 7 labels, fixed build: 7 documents in sync
